name: postmortem-ai-api
description: No JS dependencies -- this is a FastAPI/Python backend. This file exists only because the Vercel team's enforced Install Command runs `bun install --frozen-lockfile` on every project regardless of framework; an empty package.json + bun.lock lets that step succeed as a no-op so the real Python dependency install (requirements.txt, via Vercel's FastAPI framework preset) can proceed.
